resources.string: %1$s, with the user ID %2$s, has added you to their contacts. Do you want to add this person to your contacts?
Check the date and time on your device
The connection to the network failed because of a security certificate error. Setting the date and time correctly — preferably to automatic — usually fixes this.
Your device clock differs from the network clock, and for that reason the relay server is rejecting you; as long as the difference remains, no message reaches you. Set the date and time to automatic.
This account is active on another device

Another device is connected to the network with this same identity, and incoming messages are going to it. Each identity works on only one device at a time; to use this device, close the app on the other one.
The app needs notification permission to receive messages in the background. While notifications are off, messages may arrive late, or not at all.

To receive messages, this app keeps its connection open in the background, and Android requires an ongoing notification for that. Without this permission, messages may arrive late, or only while the app is open.
You need a node in order to reach your contacts. A node provides the path your messages travel; the contents of the messages remain end-to-end encrypted and are not readable by the node.
These nodes are meant for testing and will be removed on 31 December 2026.
Enter the address of a node you have access to. A vmnode: link is also accepted.
A node is a standalone service and is not created on this device: run it on a publicly reachable server, following the project\'s setup guide, then enter its address here.
Reaching your contacts requires a node. You can add the node of your choice later from Settings.
To send content, first add a contact and start a conversation.
A voice call needs microphone permission.
Calling this contact is not available.
